in_marathi.name: Narayn
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narayn हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Narayan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nara' meaning man and 'Ayan' meaning protector or rest. It is believed that the name signifies the supreme god Vishnu who is the protector and sustainer of the universe. This name is also associated with the belief that the divine power resides within each individual, providing them with strength and guidance.
